intended_object: This is the additive map M' ⊗_R S → X, m ⊗ s ↦ m·s, obtained from a right R-linear map h : M' → (restriction of X along f). It is one piece of the extension/restriction adjunction for right modules. The docstring says outright that it is "an implementation detail of `ModuleCat.RightExtension.HomEquiv.fromRestriction`".
explanation: The docstring calls this definition an implementation detail of `fromRestriction`. It builds only the underlying additive homomorphism of the map M' ⊗_R S → X, sending m ⊗ s to op(s) • h(m), by applying `BalancedTensorProduct.lift` to a balanced biadditive map. The balancing condition is checked correctly. Downstream code then turns this map into a right S-linear morphism, which is the step that gives the hom-set bijection of the adjunction. Because it is a helper step in building that bijection and not a mathematical notion in its own right, it is classified as not a mathematical object.
